mathematical_invariants_extracted.critical_mortgage_loss_threshold: A 3.5% to 5% mortgage default rate caused 25% CDO collateral loss, directly impairing AAA tranches
mathematical_invariants_extracted.ted_spread_blowout: Surged from 22 bps baseline to 240 bps on August 9, 2007 (10x expansion)
mathematical_invariants_extracted.shadow_banking_abcp_mismatch: Funding 30-year subprime mortgages via 30-day ABCP rollover
mathematical_invariants_extracted.solvency_liquidity_equivalence: Uncertainty regarding counterparty toxic debt holdings produced total interbank cash hoarding
mathematical_invariants_extracted.epiphany_equation_credit: Omega_Credit = [(100 - ABX_BBB-) / ABX_Par] * (TED_t / TED_baseline) * [Assets_Shadow / Tier1] * exp(d_Loss_CDO / d_rho_macro)
